the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Let Z be the irreducible component of R through e, which is unique by the geometrically-irreducible lemma, thought of as an integral closed subscheme. The integral closures k'_s of s(k) and k'_t of t(k) in Gamma(Z, O_Z) are fields (varieties integral-closure-ground-field lemma) and equal as subrings by the unique base field proposition. Since e factors through Z, the displayed commutative diagram shows k'_s = s(k) and k'_t = t(k), whence s(k) = t(k) and then s = t; in other words Z is a closed subscheme of the stabilizer G = R times over (t, s) and the diagonal of U over U. The lemma follows as both G and R are equidimensional, by the locally-finite-type-dimension lemma and the groupoids group-scheme-over-field lemma: the component Z of R lies inside G, so dim(G) is squeezed between dim(Z) and dim(R) = dim(Z). (source lines 1561-1587)
